We're It...! |enva=[[Rodger Parsons]] |java=[[Kenta Miyake]] }} '''Enta''' (Japanese: '''エンタ''' ''Enta'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|DP}}. He is the [[mayor]] of [[Hearthome City]] and serves as an announcer for several {{cat|Pokémon competitions}} within the city. He first appeared in ''[[DP050|Tag! We're It...!]]''. ==History== Enta debuted in ''[[DP050|Tag! We're It...!]]'', where he was seen welcoming [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] {{pkmn|Trainer}}s to [[Hearthome City]]. He revealed he would host the [[Hearthome City Tag Battle Competition]] and then explained the proceedings to all the contestants and the audience. He asked the competing Trainers to check their registration cards and use the numbers as a guide to find their Tag Battle partners, which had been randomly decided. [[File:Hearthome Gym inauguration.png|thumb|left|250px|Mayor Enta and [[Fantina]] in the inauguration of the [[Hearthome Gym]]]] After everyone located their partners, he announced that the winning team would receive two [[Soothe Bell]]s, one for each Trainer. He also said the competition would only start later that day, advising Trainers to {{pkmn|training|practice}} in the meantime. When the competition really began, Enta explained the rules, saying that each Trainer was allowed to use one {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, [[Recall|substitutions]] were prohibited, the battles had no time limit, and whichever team ended up [[Fainting|unable to battle]] would be eliminated. He also provided commentary during the competition. In ''[[DP051|Glory Blaze!]]'', Enta continued to comment on the battles and announced the semifinalists of the event. In ''[[DP052|Smells Like Team Spirit!]]'', he handed out the two Soothe Bells to {{Ash}} and [[Paul]] as their prize for winning the Hearthome City Tag Battle Competition, after they defeated {{an|Dawn}} and [[Conway]] in the final round. In ''[[DP086|Arriving in Style!]]'', Enta hosted the [[Hearthome Collection]], a fashion show for [[Pokémon Stylist]]s whose winner would get the chance to work on a photo shoot for the {{DL|Magazines in the Pokémon world|Poké Chic}} magazine. Enta appeared briefly in a flashback in ''[[DP093|Playing The Leveling Field!]]'', where he was shown along with [[Fantina]] in the inauguration of the [[Hearthome Gym]]. ==Character== Enta is a very active person who likes to be involved in the {{cat|Pokémon competitions}} taking place in [[Hearthome City]]. He seems to enjoy working as an announcer, as he is always excited when giving a running commentary of an event.
